scientific.integrity: The primary publisher text was inspected at the model equations, boundedness/extinction calculation, equilibrium analysis, and Figure 3 parameter set. A highly relevant prior Crowley-Martin stage-structured paper was inspected through its model, reproduction number, extinction theorem, and permanence theorem. A classical Beddington-DeAngelis stage-structured paper was checked for broader threshold context. The bundled checker independently replays the source-parameter contradictions and exact witness; the extinction theorem is analytic. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The theorem gives a strict sufficient predator-extinction condition, not a necessary-and-sufficient threshold for the full fear-delay system. It does not reassess the paper's full bifurcation catalogue or claim novelty for reproduction-number threshold methods in general.

title: A corrected delay-independent predator-extinction threshold in a fear-stage model
